Quiet streets, busy households

Murphy is the kind of place people move to on purpose: a smaller, mostly residential city tucked between Plano, Wylie and Sachse, with family homes on calm streets and everyday errands along FM 544 and Murphy Road. It feels quiet. The households inside usually aren't. School runs, practices, work calls and a dog who needs to go out all add up, and the cleaning is the first thing that slides.

That's where we come in. Our house cleaning in Murphy, TX is built for busy family homes: steady, thorough visits that keep the kitchen, the bathrooms and the floors under control so your weekends stay yours. We're based in Richardson, which borders Murphy to the southwest, so you're practically next door.

"It's always a great feeling after she's done cleaning our living space to know that it's been thoroughly swept, wiped, dusted, and vacuumed to perfection. Highly recommend!" — Tom R., recurring client (Yelp review)

Cleaning services for Murphy homes

  • Recurring cleaning: weekly, every other week or monthly. The best fit for most Murphy families.
  • Standard cleaning: kitchens, bathrooms, dusting and floors, done thoroughly.
  • Deep cleaning: bathroom cleaning down to the grout, baseboard cleaning in every room, cabinet cleaning on fronts and handles (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), plus appliance cleaning inside the oven and fridge.
  • Move-in / move-out cleaning: an empty-home clean for buyers, sellers and renters.
  • Pet-friendly house cleaning: extra attention on pet hair, with eco-friendly, pet-safe products.
  • Airbnb and short-term rental cleaning: turnovers scheduled around your checkouts.
  • Post-construction cleaning: dust removal after a remodel or new flooring.

Also available: one-time cleaning and apartment and condo cleaning.

What a Murphy clean covers

  • Kitchen: counters, backsplash, sink, stovetop, appliance exteriors, microwave and cabinet fronts
  • Bathrooms: toilets, tubs, showers, mirrors, sinks and fixtures cleaned and sanitized
  • Living areas and bedrooms: reachable surfaces dusted, beds made, trash emptied
  • Floors: vacuumed and mopped throughout
  • Deep cleans add: spot-cleaned baseboards, ceiling fans, blinds, switch plates, window sills, cabinet fronts (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), soap scum and grout, and inside the oven and fridge

Family dog? Two cats? Bring them on

Plenty of Murphy homes come with a backyard and a dog to go with it. We're pet-friendly, and we work calmly around your animals. Tell us about them in the booking form, and we'll plan for the hair on the rugs and the paw prints on the back door. Pet homes usually stay fresh longest on a weekly or every-other-week plan.
